body: Open owner decision from the architecture brainstorm Q12. The feature catalogue proposed the record model in core with sql/ent stores in contrib; the reference study proposed a separate module requiring only sqlb (the ubgo/auth model). Brainstorm recommends B (sqlb-only), extracting a Store interface only if a second store appears. Record the answer as an ADR in the internal notes.
title: Decide Q12: file records in a sqlb-only records module (recommended) or behind a Store interface in the stdlib core
